user.title: CasaSmart Hub
user.description: Set up the CasaSmart hub on this Home Assistant instance. A fresh install requires an explicit production HTTPS relay origin and a short-lived, single-use activation code from the CasaSmart Installer Console.

data_description.push_relay_url: Enter the production HTTPS origin supplied by the installer, for example https://relay.example.com. Paths, credentials, queries, fragments, IP addresses, and local hostnames are not accepted.
data_description.relay_activation_code: Paste the single-use CSACT1 code generated by the installer. It is stored only until relay enrollment succeeds, then removed automatically.
data_description.cloudflare_domain: The hub's public Cloudflare tunnel hostname, e.g. my-ha.example.com — leave empty if this hub has no tunnel. The tunnel is enabled right away and stays on (pairing happens over the LAN address directly, so remote access never has to be interrupted); the integration options keep a manual on/off switch for emergencies.

error.invalid_relay_url: Enter the explicit production HTTPS relay origin supplied by the installer, with no path, credentials, query, or fragment.
error.invalid_activation_code: Enter a complete CSACT1 activation code from the CasaSmart Installer Console.
error.invalid_domain: Enter a plain domain like my-ha.example.com (or paste its https:// address) — no path, port, or query.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one CasaSmart hub is allowed per Home Assistant instance.

init.title: CasaSmart Hub options

data_description.push_relay_url: Production HTTPS origin only, for example https://relay.example.com. Paths, credentials, queries, fragments, IP addresses, and local hostnames are not accepted.
data_description.relay_activation_code: Paste a fresh single-use CSACT1 code to register or re-register this Hub. It is never stored in options and is deleted from config-entry data after the relay acknowledges it.
data_description.cloudflare_domain: Public tunnel hostname, e.g. my-ha.example.com. Clear it to stop advertising a remote path to phones.
data_description.tunnel_enabled: ON starts the cloudflared add-on and sets it to start on boot. OFF stops it and disables start-on-boot, so it stays down across reboots until re-enabled here.

error.invalid_relay_url: Enter a production HTTPS relay origin such as https://relay.example.com, with no path, credentials, query, or fragment.
error.invalid_activation_code: Enter a complete CSACT1 activation code from the CasaSmart Installer Console, or leave the field empty.
error.activation_required: Changing the push relay server requires a fresh complete Hub activation code.
error.invalid_domain: Enter a plain domain like my-ha.example.com (or paste its https:// address) — no path, port, or query.
error.domain_required: Enter a Cloudflare tunnel domain before enabling the tunnel.
